topNews.text: 4 Different Bobkittens Rescued in a Week, Undergoing Rehab Together for Return to the Wild
topNews.excerpt: These two incredible animals are bobkittens, and they’re lucky to be alive. They are 2 of 4 baby bobcats rescued within days of each other, from as many as 3 different mothers—all of whom either died, or lost or abandoned the kittens. topNews.text: Bloomberg Donates $260 Million to Ensure New High Seas Treaty Translates to Lasting Ocean Protections
topNews.excerpt: Bloomberg Philanthropies has identified a funding shortfall in the implementation of many countries’ ocean protection plans, and has attempted to fill it with a quarter-billion dollar donation.
